verdict: Meta is delivering leads efficiently; Google spend needs to start converting.
narrative: This period, all 118 leads came from Meta at a cost of $25.16 per lead — and the pace accelerated sharply in the final days of the window, confirming the trend is real. Google Ads ran $1,899 in spend over the same 28 days and recorded zero conversions, meaning roughly two-thirds of your total ad budget produced no measurable lead activity. We are addressing Google's tracking and conversion setup as a priority, with offline conversion import scheduled to go live by end of August. Separately, leads are arriving into your pipeline but not advancing past intake — that is a follow-up process issue, not an ads issue, and it is being worked alongside the broader CRM build-out this month.

highlights.phrase: leads received this period, all from Meta
cost per lead on Meta — down 42% from the prior week
spent on Google Ads this period with zero conversions recorded

watch_item.issue: Google Ads has consumed $1,899 this period with no recorded conversions, leaving its true performance unmeasurable.
watch_item.fix: Offline conversion tracking is being connected and conversion import goes live by August 31, which will give Google's campaigns accurate signal to optimize against.
